design_acceptance: Keep all v1 rows readable with unchanged v1 restoration behavior.
Count exact normalized v1 logical JSON bytes before compression/encryption; no page-local counters or compression-based admission bypass.
Bound single-value encoding, page/manifest, descriptors, aggregate staging/durable bytes, CPU, cancellation and cleanup.
Authenticate scope/attempt/page identity and digest; fenced atomic manifest admission preserves previous valid receipt and hides staging.
Preserve built-in list/dict types, values/order/duplicates and independent mutable copies where v1 JSON decoding creates them.
Prove tenant isolation, key rotation, crash, lost-ack, fresh worker, retry, cancellation and SQL rollback before implementation.
An alternate admission unit that accepts a raw v1 envelope over 64,000,000 bytes needs separate policy approval; none is granted here.
